scene.head: tilt
scene.placeText: the tiny tidal islet at the far end of the low-tide causeway beyond her world's capital on a clear winter night — the white lighthouse behind her, wet dark stones and pools of seawater shining around her feet, green aurora curtains rippling overhead and the steaming city lights along the bay
scene.ownProp: a clear Iceland spar crystal set in a slim silver ring-frame, splitting the light that passes through it into two shining rays
scene.outfit: a sunstone-keeper look fitted to her body — a strapless white bodice trimmed with soft white fur over a high-slit flowing skirt, a sheer floor-sweeping cape rippling from green into violet like an aurora curtain, an ice-crystal crown set with a clear sunstone and silver sandals
scene.scene: she is the sunstone keeper of the tidal lighthouse, raising her clear crystal of Iceland spar toward the sky so it splits the aurora light into two shining rays and shows the lost ships the way home

prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Icelandic woman — the personification of Reykjavik — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Reykjavik as her world knows it — a city of a Western myth-world: carved stone and pale wood, glowing painted patterns, silk, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the tiny tidal islet at the far end of the low-tide causeway beyond her world's capital on a clear winter night — the white lighthouse behind her, wet dark stones and pools of seawater shining around her feet, green aurora curtains rippling overhead and the steaming city lights along the bay
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a sunstone-keeper look fitted to her body — a strapless white bodice trimmed with soft white fur over a high-slit flowing skirt, a sheer floor-sweeping cape rippling from green into violet like an aurora curtain, an ice-crystal crown set with a clear sunstone and silver sandals, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a clear Iceland spar crystal set in a slim silver ring-frame, splitting the light that passes through it into two shining rays up beside her face; it is all she holds.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.
Scene note: she is the sunstone keeper of the tidal lighthouse, raising her clear crystal of Iceland spar toward the sky so it splits the aurora light into two shining rays and shows the lost ships the way home

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a clear Iceland spar crystal set in a slim silver ring-frame — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, sunglasses, bucket hat, beanie, sun visor, acetate.
